RECRUITMENT RULES FOR THE POSTS IN PAF
RECRUITMENT RULES FOR THE
POSTS IN PAF
BASES/UNIT UNDER THE
MINISTRY OF DEFENCE
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
22nd February, 2012]
S.R.O.168(I)/2012,
dated 21-2-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Sub-Rule (2) of Rule
3 of the Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer), Rules, 1973, the
following amendments shall be made in the Recruitment Rules for the posts in
PAF Bases/Unit under Ministry of Defence, notified vide S.R.O.203(I)/79, dated
27th February, 1979 namely:--
(i) The
words/brackets/figures "Head Clerk (BPS-9)" wherever occurring shall
be substituted with the words/brackets/figures "Head Clerk (BPS-14)".
(ii) In
rules 2, the following 2nd proviso shall be added:--
Provided
further that initially the upgraded posts of Head Clerk (BPS-14) shall be
filled by promotion of the existing incumbents of the posts of Head Clear
(BPS-9) provided they have in service as Head Clerk (BPS-9).
2. This
Notification issues with the concurrence of the Establishment Division vide
O.M. No.4-2-2005-R-5 dated 15 February, 2012.
